description: 2026-09-18 floor session, PERSON approach. Drive to the nearest confirmed semantic track of a person at 0.4 m/s (the operating floor) and stop with the car's front 1.0 m from the person's near edge -- deliberately twice the default gap (0.5) for the first run of the stop latch on the car. mpc_corr latches the stop at object_reach_tol_m + object_stop_distance_m past that gap, so expect the car's front to REST about 1.08-1.11 m from the person's near edge (rig, measured and longest-measured braking), up to 1.28 m with 5 cm of track jitter; never inside 1.0. Same requirements as go_to_person.json. See docs/procedures/2026-09-18_go_to_floor.md.
